description: The project's full state: the onboarding stage, the runtime state, open questions, missing secrets and warnings about credentials found in the archive. Also app_health, once the app has been online: status is answering, not_answering, checking (no verdict yet) or paused (fline is putting a new version online or cannot see the server, and judges nothing). not_answering means fline's checks of the app's health_path, or of its front page when it has none, have failed for at least two minutes; problem says what fline saw and ai_text says it in a paragraph. It is usually the app's own fault: read get_logs kind=runtime and fix the app.
name: get_project
title: Get project state
